text:
tori: Quick ask — the runtime onboarding curl example 404s in staging :eyes:. Anyone own docs/runtime/onboarding/getting-started.md?

sam: I can take a quick look but last touch was by @elaine iirc. pinging @elaine to confirm.

elaine: Yup that was me. Looks like the example points at /staging-assets instead of /assets. Small fix.

sam: OK great. Can you also add `--fail` to the curl example so link-check CI surfaces broken hosts? tiny safety win.

elaine: Will do. Planned patch:
```diff
- curl -sL https://docs.redwood.ai/staging-assets/runtime/onboard/example.json | jq .
+ curl --fail -sL https://docs.redwood.ai/assets/runtime/onboard/example.json | jq .
```

elaine: I'll open a tiny PR and add myself to the frontmatter owners field while I'm there. PR will be < 5 lines.

docs-bot: link-check queued for branch `patch/curl-fix` and docs-lint queued.

ci-bot: link-check passed, docs-lint passed. staging preview rendered with unrelated image warning.

sam: Nice — once PR is up ping me and I can do a quick CR.

elaine: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/42 — added `elaine` to frontmatter owners and updated curl path + --fail.

sam: Reviewed, left one tiny wording nit on the commit message. LGTM otherwise.

elaine: Nit fixed and squashed, merging now.

tori: Thanks all :rocket: — can we add a one-line changelog entry in the docs changelog so PMs see the quick fix? not required but helpful.

elaine: Added entry to docs/CHANGELOG.md in the same PR.

sam: Perfect. Closing loop.
